lines.zh: 我顺着河底的沙纹游，条纹跟着晃。
lines.en: I swim along the riverbed's sand ripples, stripes swaying.

lines.zh: 五条鱼并排，金色把水都照暖了。
lines.en: Five fish abreast, our gold warms the water.

lines.zh: 上游的水急，我贴着石头往上走。
lines.en: The upstream current is fast; I hug the stones.

lines.zh: 湖面上有光，我朝那片亮游去。
lines.en: There is light on the lake; I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一摆，河沙就扬了起来。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and the river sand rises.

lines.zh: 高处的水清，我总往上游走。
lines.en: The water runs clear up high; I always head upstream.

lines.zh: 前面有条岔流，我拐进窄的那条。
lines.en: A fork ahead; I take the narrow branch.

lines.zh: 同伴散开又聚拢，像撒了一把铜。
lines.en: My school scatters and gathers, like scattered copper.

lines.zh: 我游过一片掉进水里的树叶。
lines.en: I swim past a leaf that fell into the water.

lines.zh: 水流托着我的腹，很轻很轻。
lines.en: The current cradles my belly, very gently.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块卵石转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle a rounded cobble twice.

lines.zh: 躲在石缝里的时候，最难认出我。
lines.en: Among the stones, I am hardest to pick out.

lines.zh: 我们游成一列，谁也不超前。
lines.en: We swim in a line and no one overtakes.

lines.zh: 下游传来声音，我停下来听。
lines.en: A sound comes from downstream; I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 我跟着水草摇的方向游。
lines.en: I swim the way the water weeds sway.

lines.zh: 阳光落进浅滩，我停在那里。
lines.en: Sunlight falls on the shallows, so I pause there.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床转弯，条纹一闪。
lines.en: I turn along the riverbed, my stripes flashing.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张向水流，吃浮游。
lines.en: I open my mouth to the current and feed.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，鳍轻轻打着拍子。
lines.en: I hover in the water, fins keeping a light beat.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面，在我背上划格子。
lines.en: Sunlight through the surface draws squares on my back.

lines.zh: 一口水从鳃里出去，又来一口。
lines.en: One mouthful of water out the gills, then another.

lines.zh: 有虫子落在水上，我没去管它。
lines.en: A bug lands on the water; I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 我数了数同伴，五条，都还在。
lines.en: I count my school: five, all still here.

lines.zh: 水草碰到我，我往旁边挪了挪。
lines.en: Weed brushes me and I shift a little aside.

lines.zh: 金色的鳞，在阴影里也发亮。
lines.en: My golden scales shine even in shadow.

lines.zh: 我有些困，可鱼从不真的睡。
lines.en: I am sleepy, though fish never truly sleep.

lines.zh: 河底的石头上长满了绿苔。
lines.en: Green moss carpets the stones of the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴又合上，什么也没吃。
lines.en: I open my mouth and close it, eating nothing.

lines.zh: 远处有船桨声，我往深处沉。
lines.en: Oars sound in the distance; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩，很多年都没有变过。
lines.en: These shallows have not changed in many years.

lines.zh: 同伴游过去，尾巴扫到了我的头。
lines.en: A schoolmate passes, tail brushing my head.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块黄石头。
lines.en: I hold perfectly still, like a yellow stone.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我浮上来看你。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; I float up to look.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，条纹就暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and my stripes dim.

lines.zh: 我不是怕你，只是有点好奇。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, only a little curious.

lines.zh: 你手上那个东西在动，是什么？
lines.en: The thing in your hand moves; what is it?

lines.zh: 我看着你的眼睛，你也看着我。
lines.en: I look into your eyes, and you look into mine.

lines.zh: 水把你的脸拉长了，看着好笑。
lines.en: The water stretches your face; it looks funny.

lines.zh: 别拍水面，那声音传得很远。
lines.en: Do not slap the water; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的倒影游了一整圈。
lines.en: I swim one full circle around your reflection.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进泥，水就浑了。
lines.en: Your boots sink into the mud and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鳃还在慢慢动着。
lines.en: I look up at you, gills still moving slowly.

lines.zh: 刀划过我的侧腹，金鳞掉了几片。
lines.en: The blade crosses my flank and gold scales fall.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，一下就没了。
lines.en: I have only two hearts; one hit is enough.

lines.zh: 我疼得乱窜，一头撞在石头上。
lines.en: I dart about in pain and run into a stone.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，是淡红的。
lines.en: My blood spreads through the water, pale red.

lines.zh: 同伴吓坏了，一下子全散了。
lines.en: My school panics and scatters all at once.

lines.zh: 我翻着肚子浮了一下，又翻回来。
lines.en: I float belly-up a moment, then right myself.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的鳍打裂了。
lines.en: That blow split my fin open.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，那里刚好容下我。
lines.en: I hide in a crevice that barely fits me.

lines.zh: 别打了，我游不过你。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I cannot outswim you.

lines.zh: 水浑了，我趁机溜走。
lines.en: The water clouds and I slip away in it.

lines.zh: 那是虫吗？它在我头顶扭来扭去。
lines.en: Is that a worm? It wriggles above my head.

lines.zh: 我闻到饵的味道，游不动了。
lines.en: I smell the bait and cannot swim away.

lines.zh: 你把钩子藏得不够好。
lines.en: You did not hide the hook well enough.

lines.zh: 我只咬一口，就一口。
lines.en: One nibble only, and then I stop.

lines.zh: 金色的影子围上来，全是同伴。
lines.en: Golden shadows crowd in; they are all my school.

lines.zh: 面包屑落下来，像下了一场雪。
lines.en: Breadcrumbs fall like a light snowfall.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴又闭上，得想清楚。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and think it through.

lines.zh: 肚子比脑子先动了。
lines.en: My belly moved before my brain did.

lines.zh: 别拉线，我还没咬稳。
lines.en: Do not pull the line; I have not bitten down yet.

lines.zh: 这条河里的鱼，都认识饵。
lines.en: Every fish in this river knows bait.

lines.zh: 你的腿踩下来，整片水都晃了。
lines.en: Your leg comes down and the whole water shakes.

lines.zh: 我撞在你小腿上，一下子弹开。
lines.en: I bump your calf and bounce straight off.

lines.zh: 鳞被蹭掉一片，我转了个圈。
lines.en: A scale rubs off and I turn a full circle.

lines.zh: 五条鱼一起躲，撞成了一团。
lines.en: Five fish dodge at once and collide in a knot.

lines.zh: 你的脚趾陷在泥里，我绕开了。
lines.en: Your toes are sunk in the mud; I go around.

lines.zh: 水被推成一股，我顺着漂开。
lines.en: The water is shoved into a current; I drift with it.

lines.zh: 这一下把我吓得窜出老远。
lines.en: That startles me into darting far away.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站的地方，一动不动。
lines.en: I hold position right where you stand.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我就换一次方向。
lines.en: Each step you take, I change direction once.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，鱼身太滑了。
lines.en: Do not grab with your hand; a fish is too slick.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我们挨得很近。
lines.en: The spring water warms and we press close.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰它，它回头碰了我。
lines.en: I touch it with a fin; it turns and touches back.

lines.zh: 浅滩的沙里，我们刨出小坑。
lines.en: In the shallows we scoop small pits in the sand.

lines.zh: 金色的卵散在石缝里，很小。
lines.en: Golden eggs scatter into the stones, very small.

lines.zh: 它游走了，我留在原地看卵。
lines.en: It swims away; I stay and watch the eggs.

lines.zh: 同伴都在，谁也不抢地方。
lines.en: The whole school is here and no one fights for room.

lines.zh: 条纹叠在一起，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Our stripes overlap and cannot be told apart.

lines.zh: 水一动，卵就被冲走一些。
lines.en: The water stirs and carries some eggs away.

lines.zh: 一年里只有这么几天。
lines.en: There are only a few such days in a year.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这里不该被踩。
lines.en: Do not come closer; this place should not be trodden.

lines.zh: 有东西落进水里，我去顶了顶。
lines.en: Something dropped into the water; I went and nudged it.

lines.zh: 是枚铁钉，凉的，我吐掉了。
lines.en: An iron nail, cold; I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我把一片叶子含住，又放了。
lines.en: I take a leaf in my mouth and let it go.

lines.zh: 水底的硬币在发亮，我咬不动。
lines.en: A coin glints on the bottom; I cannot bite it.

lines.zh: 它沉得比我游得还快。
lines.en: It sinks faster than I can swim down.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下，它翻了个面。
lines.en: I nudge it once and it flips over.

lines.zh: 这条河里，什么都有。
lines.en: People throw everything into this river.

lines.zh: 东西上有油味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: It smells of oil; I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴把它塞进卵石底下。
lines.en: I push it into a crevice to hide it.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，我们都不明白。
lines.en: My school gathers round; none of us understands it.

lines.zh: 你搅水的那一刻，我盯上你了。
lines.en: The moment you stir the water, I mark you.

lines.zh: 不是要吃你，是想弄清你。
lines.en: Not to eat you; I want to work out what you are.

lines.zh: 金光一闪，我的头就转向你。
lines.en: A flash of gold and my head turns to you.

lines.zh: 你身上有东西在反光。
lines.en: Something on you is catching the light.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里出来，朝你游过去。
lines.en: I come out from the stones and swim toward you.

lines.zh: 目标太大了，我有点紧张。
lines.en: The target is very large; I am a little nervous.

lines.zh: 同伴跟着我，一起掉了个头。
lines.en: My school follows and turns with me.

lines.zh: 水面上的动静，我全听得见。
lines.en: I hear every movement on the surface.

lines.zh: 我先绕半圈，看你动不动。
lines.en: I circle half way round to see whether you move.

lines.zh: 这条河今天来了客人。
lines.en: The river has a visitor today.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子一路走。
lines.en: I keep to the line your shadow makes.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，我就在脚边。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows; I am right at your feet.

lines.zh: 五条鱼一起绕着你转。
lines.en: Five fish circle you together.

lines.zh: 你一动，我们散开，再合上。
lines.en: You move; we scatter, then close again.

lines.zh: 我不咬，只是看着你。
lines.en: I do not bite; I only watch you.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里，像两根柱子。
lines.en: Your legs in the water look like two pillars.

lines.zh: 越靠越近，水都被挤热了。
lines.en: We press closer until the water feels warm.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就在后头跟着。
lines.en: You step back once; I advance once.

lines.zh: 金色把我们连成了一片。
lines.en: Gold ties us into a single sheet.

lines.zh: 我在等一个小小的空隙。
lines.en: I am waiting for one small gap.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚踝，只是碰一下。
lines.en: I bump your ankle, nothing more than a touch.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙齿实在太小。
lines.en: I bite once; my teeth are really too small.

lines.zh: 你脚背上留下几道浅浅的痕。
lines.en: A few shallow lines are left on your foot.

lines.zh: 我的鳞把你的脚划破了。
lines.en: My scales have scratched your foot open.

lines.zh: 撞完我就跑，鱼都是这样。
lines.en: I strike and flee; that is how fish fight.

lines.zh: 我们五条一起撞你的腿。
lines.en: The five of us ram your leg together.

lines.zh: 你踢了一脚，水花溅到岸上。
lines.en: You kick out and water splashes onto the bank.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己也晕了。
lines.en: That blow left me dizzy as well.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，被带出水面。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and am dragged out of the water.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先踩水的。
lines.en: Do not blame me; you splashed first.

lines.zh: 我是在上游的浅滩里出生的。
lines.en: I was born in a shallow reach upstream.

lines.zh: 五条一起，挤在卵石之间。
lines.en: Five of us together, wedged among the cobbles.

lines.zh: 水很清，我第一次看见光。
lines.en: The water was clear; I saw light for the first time.

lines.zh: 一生下来就带着金条纹，很显眼。
lines.en: Born with golden stripes, very conspicuous.

lines.zh: 这条河的水位，正好没过我。
lines.en: The river's level just covers me.

lines.zh: 上游没有大鱼，我们才敢留下。
lines.en: No big fish upstream; that is why we stay.

lines.zh: 同伴用尾巴碰我，叫我跟上。
lines.en: A schoolmate taps me with its tail to follow.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，沙还没落。
lines.en: I slip from a crevice, the sand still settling.

lines.zh: 湖和河交界的地方，最热闹。
lines.en: Where lake and river meet is the busiest place.

lines.zh: 水上的天很高，我看了很久。
lines.en: The sky above the water is high; I stared a long while.

lines.zh: 被火烧死的话，我会直接变成熟鱼。
lines.en: Burn me to death and I turn straight into cooked fish.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔到石头上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I fall from the water onto stone and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃贴在头上发干。
lines.en: Out of water my gills dry against my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河水掀起来，我也跟着飞。
lines.en: The blast throws the river up and me with it.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水面，扎进了我的背。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water into my back.

lines.zh: 魔法的光，让我鳞上的金褪了。
lines.en: Magic light bleaches the gold from my scales.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，条纹会慢慢变淡。
lines.en: Hungry too long, my stripes slowly fade.

lines.zh: 闪电打进河里，我整条都麻了。
lines.en: The bolt hits the river and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我张着嘴落下去。
lines.en: No water in the void; I fall with my mouth open.
